methodology: Manually curated, per company, from each company's own official most-recently-published environmental/sustainability report (or, for Oracle, its official ESG datasheet). This is NOT part of the automated daily SEC refresh (tools/fetch_company_sources.py / fetch_public_context.py never touch this file) -- unlike SEC financials, corporate sustainability reports are published once a year by each company on its own schedule, so there is no free, structured, continuously-refreshing source for this data (see DATA_PROVENANCE.md). Every figure below is either REAL (directly stated by the company's own report) or DERIVED (simple arithmetic on REAL figures, e.g. a percentage share). Any figure that could not be confirmed against a primary source, or where independent lookups returned conflicting numbers, is intentionally omitted rather than guessed -- the dashboard renders those fields as unavailable rather than silently filling them.
